title: Affection
subtitle: How the bot feels about each person, isolated per instance
scopeBanner: Only affection under this instance is listed and editable; other instances stay invisible

focus.title: Focus
focus.hint: Presets sit in the middle with people around them; thicker lines mean higher scores, the colour is the closeness, and dashed lines mean wary or hostile. Click a person to see their affection, call name, milestones and when they were last seen. Drag or scroll to pan; hold Ctrl or Command while scrolling to zoom.

graph.truncated: Showing the {{drawn}} most recently updated of {{total}}; search or filter by closeness to narrow it down
graph.skippedMerged: {{count}} more belong to merged secondary accounts and are not drawn
graph.empty: No affection records for the current scope and filters yet.
graph.notFound: This instance does not exist or is outside what you can manage.

columns.mergedInto: Merged into {{person}}; this row is dormant, editing it has no effect

empty.title: Nobody remembered yet
empty.hint: Affection builds up as conversations happen. If nothing shows up, enable the affection system in system settings first.

scope.notInUseWarning: No channel currently uses this share: channels are using this person's share under another preset, so changes here won't affect ongoing conversations.

detail.title: This relationship
detail.loadFailed: This affection record is not visible or no longer exists (it may have been reset, or it belongs to another instance)
detail.scopeLine: This affection belongs to: domain {{domain}} / preset {{preset}}
detail.presetDeleted: That preset was deleted; this data is kept as an orphan (never cascade-deleted, clean it up manually under Console → Identity & Domains)
detail.milestonesHint: Relationship changes recorded automatically; they are part of long-term memory
detail.milestonesEmpty: No milestones yet. The bot records one when the relationship changes.
detail.milestonesGone: The memory behind this milestone was permanently deleted; only this record is left.
detail.milestonesMoved: The instance that wrote this milestone was transferred to another tenant and the memory went with it; only this record is left.
detail.notesHint: Notes written by an admin; they are part of the worldbook

adjustDialog.title: Adjust affection
adjustDialog.description: Set the score of {{share}} directly. Only the score changes; to change the impression use "Edit impression" or "Clear impression only".
adjustDialog.scoreHelper: Ranges from -100 to 200; values outside are clamped
adjustDialog.reasonHelper: Recorded in the change history for later reference

resetDialog.title: Reset affection
resetDialog.description: This clears the score of {{share}} and wipes the impression and call name the bot wrote. Shares under other presets are not affected; it will build up again from the next conversation.
resetDialog.alsoMilestones: This also deletes the relationship milestones of this share (soft delete, recoverable on the memory page)

clearDialog.title: Clear impression only
clearDialog.description: This wipes the impression, the recent note and the call name of {{share}}. The score stays. The bot will write a new one after the next conversation.

editDialog.title: Edit impression
editDialog.description: Rewrite the impression and the recent note of {{share}}. The score stays. Later conversations will keep evolving it from here.
editDialog.callNameHelper: Up to {{max}} characters; leave blank for no call name
editDialog.callNameTooLong: Longer than {{max}} characters; shorten it to save
editDialog.lengthHelper: Up to {{max}} characters; anything longer is cut off on save

deleteReasonDialog.title: Delete this reason
deleteReasonDialog.description: Only the reason text of this entry is removed: the score and the entry itself stay, with a deletion trace. The impression and recent note are not affected; use "Clear impression only" or "Edit impression" for those.

deleteMilestoneDialog.title: Delete this relationship milestone?
deleteMilestoneDialog.description: Soft delete: it disappears from prompts and retrieval but stays under "Deleted" on the memory page, so it can be recovered.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load the affection list
